description: Summon Hawk 190 Mana 35 yd range 6 sec cooldown Requires Hunter Requires level 60 Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [108 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
name: Summon Hawk
